meta.v2Files: apps/client/public/art/ui/<name>.png -> frames of the same name (one atlas); v2 CSS slice 8 (panel) / 6 (button) -> meta.nineSlice

anim.spinner: spinner_0..8, 3 grid frames each = 0.9 s per turn (v2 .ct-spinner 0.9 s linear)
anim.switch: switch_0 (off) -> switch_1, switch_2 (2 grid frames each) -> switch_3 (on): 4 grid frames = 133 ms (v2 transform 120 ms); reverse for off
anim.button: hover = button-hover immediately (v2 80 ms bg transition < 3 grid frames); press = button-pressed (plate 1 px down) while held
anim.modal: open: scrim + modal pop (frame 0 one step smaller, 2 grid frames); close: 3-step Bayer dissolve at 15 fps (kit envelope)
anim.caret: 16 grid frames on / 16 off (533 ms, browser caret blink)
anim.toggle: notebook mark toggles pop: 1 step smaller for 2 grid frames, then full
anim.checkbox: check: checkbox-pop (the ON drawing with a 1-step smaller tick) for 2 grid frames, then checkbox-on; never another state's drawing
anim.reducedMotion: spinner shows spinner_0 still; switch jumps to the end drawing; no pops (docs/UI.md §2.8)

meta.fonts: titles = hud DISPLAY face (out/ui/hud-font.json), small caps = hud LABEL (kit tiny + 5-wide M/W); body = kit body
meta.css: out/ui/panels.css (border-image rules at the integer scale --px; drop in after theme.css)

newStyle.button-pressed|disabled|selected: button states (selected = gold edge, pressed = plate 1 px down; distinguishable without colour)
newStyle.modal: modal panel with gold corner brackets
newStyle.row*: list rows (members, notebook seats, ST seat grid)
newStyle.scroll-*: parchment pamphlet: rolled top / bottom caps + body
newStyle.scrim: modal scrim tile (the one translucent token)
newStyle.badge-*: composed tiny-caps badges (You, Host, Not ready, Ready, Storyteller, alive, dead, NOW, NEXT, SAVED, good, evil)
newStyle.toggle_*: 7x7 notebook mark toggles (toggle_<n>-off = flat textDim mark, no outline)
newStyle.badge-unread: chat unread count pill 9-slice (v2 .ct-chat-unread, danger; LABEL digits, 99+ cap)
newStyle.checkbox-pop: checkbox pop drawing (on, 1 step smaller tick)
newStyle.chat-*: chat dock samples (row 44, composed from the kit; screens.js chat / chatFolded): chat-dock_sample (open), chat-tabs_sample, chat-crier-line_sample, chat-folded_sample / _crier / _read (peek line + Chat toggle + unread pill), chat-peek_sample
